summary.headline: UniTestInc. signs KRW 5.73bn semiconductor test equipment supply deal with SK hynix
summary.what_happened: UniTestInc. disclosed a single supply contract to supply semiconductor test equipment (GEN6 SSD TESTER) to SK hynix, a South Korea-based semiconductor manufacturer. The contract is unconditional, has a period from Nov 23, 2026 to Mar 26, 2027, and was signed on Nov 23, 2026. The filing states the contract amount excludes VAT.

key_numbers.label: Payment terms
key_numbers.value: 90% after equipment delivery, 10% after setup completion; no advance payment

summary.why_it_matters: Single supply contract disclosures in Korea report a specific order's size relative to the company's recent revenue, which helps shareholders gauge the scale of an individual order. Such filings do not by themselves indicate the company's overall financial outlook.
